correctness.rationale: For every integer b>=2 the b full affine branches preserve Lebesgue measure. The observable f_b(x)=|T_b(x)-x| is coordinate-Euclidean and piecewise affine, not the shortest circle displacement. Direct branch integration yields mean (2b-1)/(6b) and lag-zero variance (2b^2-2b-1)/(36b^2). The Perron image of the centered f has a finite break-point piecewise-affine shape; its next image is exactly b^-2 times that centered shape. Integrating f*Pf supplies C_1=(b-4)(b-2)(b^2-b-1)/(180b^4), hence C_n=b^[-2(n-1)] C_1 for each positive lag. Stationary covariance summation gives variance (12b^4-24b^3+11b^2+6b-11)/(180b^2(b^2-1)), positive for b>=2. Summable Perron iterates give bounded Gordin coboundary and reverse-martingale difference, proving a nondegenerate CLT under stationary Lebesgue initial x. The initial endpoint conventions affect a null set only; zero covariance at b=2,4 does NOT assert stochastic independence. Independently integrated the product of exact affine branches at b=2..6 and lags 1,2 using rational three-interior-point quadratic quadrature, reproducing sign reversal b=3 and b>=5 and zeros b=2,4. These finite calculations corroborate, rather than replace, the general transfer identity and CLT argument.

value.rationale: Natural path-length fluctuation statistic for a standard expanding dynamical family; the unexpected complete disappearance of all positive-lag memory at b=2 and b=4, negative memory at 3, and positive memory thereafter is a parameter boundary with an exact Green–Kubo calibration. The CLT supplies a meaningful trajectory-level consequence, not merely a symbolic substitution or low-order variance computation.

limitations: Only integer b>=2, stationary Lebesgue law and coordinate-Euclidean step length; does not treat circular geodesic or arbitrary initial distributions.
All-lag zero covariance for b in {2,4} is not independence; CLT requires the ergodic stationary expanding map.
